parts.name: be
sources: MakeHuman (CC0): the person of the figure.
The sizes of the order and their sources are in the extras ("sizes"); a size with no source is an estimate.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): the front of the block is a little curved (photos 1, 4: in between its corner piers).
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a block about 12 m to 14 m wide (photo 4: about square).

measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photo 1: the block from the plaza to the terrace about 6.5 m (the relief of 3 m, its frame, the band of letters, the small windows, the foot band); ±15%. en.wikipedia, Christ of Vũng Tàu: a platform of 4 m (36 m in all), which does not agree.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a block about 12 m to 14 m wide, with round corners. amazingvietnam.vn (2010), the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ: the base 12 m long.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photo 1: about 3 m with its drum of 0.6 m, from the face of the dome and the view down of about 45 degrees; ±15%.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a low dome with 8 faces.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a narrow stair up the front of the dome to the feet (1.2 m, an estimate).
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a low dome with 8 faces, about 8 m wide.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): small square windows with grilles under the relief (photo 1: two).
amazingvietnam.vn (2010), the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ: each hand 2.2 m long (the middle finger 1.1 m).
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photo 3: about 4 m from the top of the head to the end of the beard, the face about 1.6 m wide; the hair to the shoulders, a beard.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photos 1, 3, 5: the Sacred Heart in relief on the chest, about 0.7 m wide and 1.6 m high with its flame, about 24 m to 25 m over the feet.
vi.wikipedia, Tượng Chúa Kitô Vua (Vũng Tàu): 32 m. The owner: from the feet to the top of the halo.
by eye from the photo Statue_of_Jesus_in_Vung_Tau.jpg (Wikimedia Commons, Category:Christ of Vung Tau): the arms a little over the level.

measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photos 1, 3, 4: the lower edge of the mantle level, about 21 m to 22 m over the feet, with a point at the front center; about 5.5 m to 6.5 m wide at its edge.
amazingvietnam.vn (2010), the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ: reinforced concrete with a render of washed stone.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a wide relief in gold color, about 8 m × 3 m, in a white frame.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a wide relief in gold color, about 8 m × 3 m, in a white frame.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photo 4: a round plaza about 21 m across; ±15%.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photo 1: 3 steps in rings round the base (15 cm each, an estimate).

measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photos 1, 3, 4: 3 or 4 straight rays at the left and at the right of the ring, out to about 7 m across. amazingvietnam.vn (2010), the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ: 9 rays of metal in the halo, which are also lightning rods (3 at each side and 3 at the top).
amazingvietnam.vn (2010), the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ: front the Last Supper, back the keys to Peter, the sides Christ before Pilate and the three Magi.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photos 1, 3, 4: 2 or 3 thin rods at the top of the ring. amazingvietnam.vn (2010), the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ: 9 rays of metal in all.
vi.wikipedia, Tượng Chúa Kitô Vua (Vũng Tàu): the arms 18.4 m wide.
vi.wikipedia, Tượng Chúa Kitô Vua (Vũng Tàu): 133 steps in a spiral from the base to the shoulders.
measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md): a terrace with 8 sides and a pierced balustrade, about 11 m to 14 m wide.

measured from photos (Vung_Tau landmarks.md), photos 1, 3, 4, 5: 3 small rectangular windows in one line down the center of the robe, each about 0.5 m wide and 0.8 m high, about 2.5 m to 3 m apart, with a square lattice grille; the first one about 20 m over the feet.

parts.name: cau_thang
sources: The stair: 133 steps of 17.9 cm, 12 to a turn, round an open well of 1.0 m with a rail (by eye from the photo of the inside).

parts.name: lan_can
sources: The balustrade of the terrace: 1.0 m high, pierced (by eye from the photos).
